window.status: source frozen; parent owns compilation and numerical/performance verification
window.scope: Canonical device implementations and shared window IO only; ABI wrappers maintained by root.
preservation_notes: Arithmetic expressions, operand order, loop pragmas, caching intrinsics, synchronization and existing branch order were retained during helper expansion.
Local device lambdas replace previously force-inlined repeated prefill/refill/addressing functions; lambda bodies are visible in each canonical owner.
Pooled spatial publication expands the same original PublishSpatialProjection<bFp8,1,false> specialization, with its compile-time discarded plane branch omitted.
FFN pipeline helpers now use owning Profile<bFp8,bInputView> for invariant element/reduction/tile-size constants; all accessed helper constants are equal to the original Profile<bFp8> values.
C32 fusion keeps register-only storage; wide fusion owns and reuses the original FSharedWindow slab.
No build, GPU execution, benchmarking or commit performed by this subagent.
signature_changes: RunWindowFfn<bFp8,bInputView>(Parameters): removed external s_Storage parameter; internal aligned 8208 bytes.
RunWindowQkv<bFp8>(Parameters): removed external s_Storage parameter; internal aligned Profile::s_BarrierBase+16 bytes.
RunSpatialProjection<...>(Parameters): removed external s_Storage parameter; internal aligned StageCount*(4096+8) bytes.
New RunWindowDownsample<Channels,bFp8>(Parameters) and RunWindowUpsample<Channels,bFp8>(Parameters) own fused sequencing; exported ABI wrappers call these directly.
RunWindowWide signature unchanged; shared-slab reference is intentional fusion lifetime sharing.
